order: Address four findings raised by this round's review, while confirming that all five prior-round closures still hold. Change the touches lint to compare individual elements in place of a comma-joined string that is prone to false collisions. Make the glob matcher replicate the line-terminator character classes of the regular expression it replaced exactly, with no deviation. Have checkout startup sweep any abandoned worktrees still on disk, since pruning alone clears registrations whose directory is already missing, and nothing more. Live in-process checkouts must remain exempt from that sweep in every case. Correct future review orders so they enumerate every commit in their pinned range, rather than overclaiming a single commit, since the range should never collapse down to just one entry when more than one commit sits in scope, and a truncated range can mislead a later audit. Enter that verdict into the roster word for word, and leave the tranche open until the next pass.
claims: The touches lint now compares elements in place of a collision-prone comma join, and the glob matcher replicates the retired regular expression's line-terminator classes exactly. Checkout startup sweeps abandoned worktrees still on disk, since pruning alone only clears missing-directory registrations, while exempting live in-process checkouts. Future review orders now enumerate every commit in their pinned range, and that verdict sits inside the roster, unaltered. Verifier closed at 94 passed, and registry and router both hold clean on the same local run.
